what was measured: Safari A 30, a loose 57x60 RECTANGLE at depth 1 on page 10266:7 (not a grid instance). get_screenshot on the node: a purple-and-yellow STRIPED CANDY BALL with a twisted wrapper nub, a 3D sphere. CORRECTED LATER THE SAME PASS: a full-size get_screenshot of the board 11146-1937 shows this master IS THE MULTIPLIER ART - the six multiplier cells draw a purple striped candy-bomb with a lit fuse and their figure in gold over it, and what read as a "twisted wrapper nub" at 57x60 is the fuse. So it is not a plain reel symbol. NOT-WIRED rather than partial because the art is absent by DECISION, not by oversight, and the decision is now a bigger one than the symbol set: skin.ts:255 maps GEM_SYMBOL_KEYS to build the reel strip, and wiring this master would be drawing a MULTIPLIER FEATURE the engine neither implements nor pays. A lane never touches that. No asset exported.
